title: Cantor showed the real numbers are not equinumerous with the naturals
summary: Peter Koellner's SEP entry records Cantor's 1874 result: more than one size of infinity.
body: Peter Koellner's Stanford Encyclopedia entry on the continuum hypothesis says that in 1874 Cantor showed a one-to-one correspondence between the natural numbers and the algebraic numbers, and that he showed there is no such correspondence between the natural numbers and the real numbers. Taking one-to-one correspondence as the test of equal size, there is more than one level of infinity. The v1 article's countable-versus-uncountable distinction is this result. Cantor's later diagonal argument is a further presentation and was not the sentence we used.
